rules.cluster: candidate merge by title similarity; zh 2-gram cosine, en word cosine, identical titles always merge, different version numbers never merge (incl. GPT-4 vs GPT-5), opposite wordings (跌破/突破 etc.) never merge, short names (zh < 5 chars, en < 2 words) merge only when identical
rules.sort: within each group: items within fresh_hours first, then more platforms first, then newest first; older items at the bottom
rules.time: MM-DD HH:MM in Asia/Shanghai; relative and date-only source times normalised
